telnyx.notReady: Add the environment variables below, then redeploy
telnyx.step1Body: In Telnyx → Programmable Voice, create a Credential connection named e.g. Tandfokus CRM.
telnyx.webhookUrlHint: Use your production URL from Settings → General → App URL if different.
telnyx.step2Body: Go to Outbound Voice Profiles → Add new profile. Link your Credential Connection and allow Sweden (SE) under destinations — the default profile only allows US/CA.
telnyx.step3Body: Open your purchased number and assign it to the Credential Connection so it can be used as caller ID on outbound calls.
telnyx.step4Body: On the Credential Connection, create an on-demand telephony credential. Copy its ID into TELNYX_TELEPHONY_CREDENTIAL_ID. The CRM uses this to mint short-lived browser login tokens via /api/token.
telnyx.step5Body: Add these to Vercel (or your host) and redeploy:
telnyx.step6Body: Open any lead with a phone number → Calls tab → Call via Browser. Allow microphone access when prompted — calls cannot connect without it. Calls are logged automatically in call history.
telnyx.troubleshootingBody: If the UI shows ringing but the other phone never rings, check Telnyx → Voice → Logs. WebRTC calls need mic permission and a working network path to Telnyx EU media servers. A +468 Stockholm local number often connects to Swedish mobiles more reliably than a +4610 national number.

envHints.callControlAppId: Call Control Application ID (Programmable Voice → Call Control Apps)

websiteForms.gtmBody: Lead forms push a generate_lead event to dataLayer after the CRM saves the lead — not on click, only on confirmed success. Use the same GTM container on Webflow and create one Custom Event trigger.
websiteForms.gtmHostedHint: Injected on hosted form pages (/f/…). Webflow sites keep GTM in Project Settings → Custom Code.
websiteForms.gtmTriggerVars: Optional data layer variables: form_source, campaign, lead_source, form_slug
websiteForms.metaBody: After a hosted or embedded form saves in the CRM, Meta Conversions API sends Lead (plus optional virtual PageView when a path is set on the form). Browser pixel events only fire if your site loads the Meta pixel. GTM should listen for generate_lead on the dataLayer.
websiteForms.metaTestOk: Meta accepted Lead, the test custom conversion, and the virtual PageView. Check Events Manager in a few minutes.
websiteForms.openaiBody: Successful enquiry forms fire dataLayer event generate_lead (same signal as GTM). OpenAI lead_created runs alongside it when the pixel is loaded. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_ADS_PIXEL_ID on Vercel for hosted /f/ forms. On Webflow: paste Richard’s init snippet in site head, then load /tandfokus-openai-ads.js (auto-fires on generate_lead). Booking and phone clicks: TandfokusOpenAi.measureAppointmentScheduled() and measurePhoneClick() on the confirmation / tel: handlers.
